title: Tenure Multiplier by Personal Account Age — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card
content:
For the credit given on filing on an incorrect-amount dispute of a purchase made with a Pocketwire Visa Debit Card single-use virtual card, the tenure multiplier depends on how many whole months the linked Pocketwire Personal Account has been open on the filing date.

| Whole months the linked Pocketwire Personal Account has been open on the filing date | Tenure multiplier |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 1.5 |
| 24 or more, but fewer than 60 | 1.25 |
| fewer than 24 | 1 |

The months are counted from the opening (sign-up) date on the personal account's record to the filing date. Only whole months count.

### Band edges (hypothetical ages)

| Whole months open | Tenure multiplier |
|---|---|
| 75 | 1.5 |
| 60 | 1.5 |
| 59 | 1.25 |
| 24 | 1.25 |
| 23 | 1 |
| 4 | 1 |
